title.en: An Act Providing for the Purchase of the Books and Other Documents of Doctor Rizal and Appropriating Funds for that Purpose.

text.en:
The librarian, Philippines Library, is hereby authorized, subject to the approval of the Secretary
of Public Instruction, to purchase the original manuscript of the novel "Noli Me Tangere," by Doctor Rizal,
and all the books, pamphlets, papers, and other documents that remain of his private library, to form part of
the Philippines Library.

For the purposes of the next preceding section, the sum of thirty-two thousand pesos, or so much
thereof as may be necessary, is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise
appropriated.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the same shall take effect on its
passage, in accordance with section one of Act Numbered Nineteen hundred and forty-five of the Philippine
Legislature.
Enacted, January 26, 1911.
